description: On increasing ordinal endpoints Sierpinski colour is exactly the comparison of their real values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.sierpinskiColoring_pair
  (r : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.OmegaOne → ℝ)
  {x y : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.OmegaOne} (hxy : x < y) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.pairValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.sierpinskiColoring r) x
      y =
    if r x < r y then 0 else 1
